question: Hriday Narayan Dixit, who received the Padma Shri award in 2025 and is a renowned thinker, philosopher, politician and social worker, belongs to which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Hriday Narayan Dixit** is a prominent thinker, philosopher, politician, and social worker hailing from the Indian state of **Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• He served as the **Speaker of the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly** from 2017 to 2022.
 
• Hriday Narayan Dixit is well-known for his contributions to social and political discourse through various literary works and philosophical writings.
 
• In 2025, he was honored with the prestigious **Padma Shri award**, which is one of India’s highest civilian awards.
 
• His work has been recognized in areas such as **philosophy, political thought, and social service**, showcasing his dedication to the betterment of society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Shri Award**

 
 
• The award recognizes the efforts of individuals who have made a significant impact on society through their work.
 
• It is awarded to individuals for their distinguished contributions in various fields such as art, literature, education, social work, public affairs, science, and sports.
 
• The Padma Shri is the fourth-highest civilian award in India, established in 1954.
